query: INSERT INTO reading_state (user_id, manifestation_id, status, rating) VALUES ($1, $2, 'want_to_read'::reading_status, 2), ($1, $3, 'reading'::reading_status, 5), ($1, $4, 'finished'::reading_status, 5) ON CONFLICT (user_id, manifestation_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, rating = EXCLUDED.rating
